function the row names that P2 did not return: The Servo supply temperature line of IOBoard.md states that the trip latches until the operator clear control (F11) clears it, and 'threshold, latch and wiring of the alert outputs: a follow-up of R6'. V283 (owner, 2026-10-01) rules a latch of the rail's own: only that converter switches off and stays off until the F11 clear. P2 lists 'Rail's own latch' among the requirements of Servo supply temperature and records the MCP9808T-E/MS failing it, but returns no function and no part for the latch itself (4 a board, one for each converter, set by that MCP9808's alert, holding that converter's EN/UVLO low, cleared by F11, off at power-up and reset). selection.json (round2) R3 already holds a latch (74LVC1G175GW,125) and a clear control (434153017835) for F11, from FU-2A; whether a copy per rail serves is not read.

The R8 row names 'the IO board's input for its sense leads'. Research.md Rules of stage 1 sends only the protection on the signal, sensor, balance-lead, link and heartbeat connectors to stage 2, and names the shunts, USB protection, power input protection and ESC pack path protection as stage 1; the external shunt's sense leads are none of the listed connectors, and IOBoard.md:464 says only 'round 2'. The TVS therefore has no entry in P2's return and no stage assigned on the page. Its clamp voltage and placement are not stated (IOBoard.md:464). The 1 kOhm resistors are resistors, left to stage 2.
